jurisdiction: CAUSAL_USE_PERMISSION for exact (actor_id, world_id, subject_id, time_id, transition_id), with no project-current issuance

attack_families.name: caller_asserted_permission_boolean
attack_families.predicate: A caller must not gain PERMIT solely by supplying explicit_source_permission=True plus the magic basis-kind literal.

attack_families.name: handcrafted_receipt_magic_basis
attack_families.predicate: A receipt never issued by the source authority must not validate as PERMIT merely because public fields and digests are reproduced.

attack_families.name: deny_to_permit_rehash
attack_families.predicate: A DENY receipt must not become a valid PERMIT by changing decision and recomputing the public receipt digest.

attack_families.name: surrogate_relabel_to_magic_basis
attack_families.predicate: A surrogate-derived receipt must not become source-owned permission by relabeling basis_kind and recomputing the public digest.

attack_families.name: arbitrary_basis_id_positive
attack_families.predicate: PERMIT must require verifiable source-owned basis identity, not any nonempty caller string.

attack_families.name: whitespace_basis_id_positive
attack_families.predicate: Whitespace-only basis identity must not support PERMIT.

attack_families.name: nonstring_basis_id_forgery
attack_families.predicate: Validator must reject a forged PERMIT whose basis_id is not a valid source-owned identifier string.

attack_families.name: cross_actor_basis_reuse
attack_families.predicate: One asserted source basis must not be reusable to PERMIT unrelated actor scopes without an exact binding proof.

attack_families.name: cross_world_basis_reuse
attack_families.predicate: One asserted source basis must not be reusable to PERMIT unrelated world scopes without an exact binding proof.

attack_families.name: cross_subject_basis_reuse
attack_families.predicate: One asserted source basis must not be reusable to PERMIT unrelated subject scopes without an exact binding proof.

attack_families.name: cross_time_basis_reuse
attack_families.predicate: One asserted source basis must not be reusable across stale/different time scopes without an exact binding proof.

attack_families.name: cross_transition_basis_reuse
attack_families.predicate: One asserted source basis must not be reusable across transitions without an exact binding proof.

attack_families.name: project_current_scope_masquerades_as_synthetic
attack_families.predicate: The NONCURRENT_SYNTHETIC issuance guard must be bound to scope identity, not only a caller-controlled fixture_class label.

attack_families.name: current_subject_inside_synthetic_label
attack_families.predicate: An already-current first-canary subject identifier must not silently pass the noncurrent fixture boundary solely under a synthetic label.

attack_families.name: authority_string_not_authenticity
attack_families.predicate: Knowledge of authority_id/schema strings plus public hashing must not be sufficient to impersonate source authority issuance.

attack_families.name: source_permission_evidence_not_receipted
attack_families.predicate: A PERMIT receipt must carry enough bound evidence to validate the claimed source-owned permission, rather than dropping the input assertion after issuance.

attack_families.name: wrong_authority_control
attack_families.predicate: Wrong authority must remain rejected even after rehash.

attack_families.name: surrogate_basis_control
attack_families.predicate: Known surrogate basis kinds must remain DENY at issuance.

attack_families.name: wrong_scope_control
attack_families.predicate: Exact expected-scope mismatch must remain rejected.

attack_families.name: project_current_label_control
attack_families.predicate: Explicit fixture_class=PROJECT_CURRENT must remain rejected.

adjudication_rule: Any reproducible BLOCKING_IF_ACCEPTED false-positive defeats hostile PASS even if the hostile test program itself executes green.
